title: Dimension inequality for a ring map and its fibre
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime lying over the prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$. Write $\operatorname{ht}$ for the height of a prime ideal (the supremum of the lengths of chains of primes descending from it), so that $\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak q=\dim S_{\mathfrak q}$ and $\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak p=\dim R_{\mathfrak p}$ for the localizations at these primes [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then $\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak q\leq\operatorname{ht}\mathfrak p+\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak q/\mathfrak pS)$, the last term being the height of the prime $\mathfrak q/\mathfrak pS$ of $S/\mathfrak pS$; equivalently $$\dim(S_{\mathfrak q})\leq\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})+\dim(S_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak pS_{\mathfrak q}).$$
